tool_analysis: Step Analysis: The recorded browser session logged into Magento admin, navigated to the Transactions grid, identified the filter row controls, closed an overlay, filled the filters, and clicked Search. The final page showed 'No records found'. Task Definition: Create a reusable tool that automates the Transactions search by filling filters (ID range, Order ID, Transaction ID, Parent Transaction ID, Payment Method, Transaction Type, Is Closed, Created At range) and clicking Search, then returning the results snapshot. Action Plan: 1) Navigate to grid URL. 2) Populate each filter control from inputs where provided. 3) Select dropdowns by visible text for Payment Method, Transaction Type, and Is Closed. 4) Click Search. 5) Wait briefly and extract the page content for verification. Variable Identification: Required/optional inputs: id_from (optional), id_to (optional), order_id (optional), transaction_id (optional), parent_transaction_id (optional), payment_method (optional, must match visible option text), transaction_type (optional, constrained enum), is_closed (optional, 'Yes'/'No'), created_from (optional, YYYY-MM-DD), created_to (optional, YYYY-MM-DD), per_page (optional). Step Optimization: Used direct navigation to the transactions URL rather than navigating through menus. Deterministic interactions are driven by recorded elementHash values for inputs/selects/clicks from the session. We combined logically-similar input steps and preserved a short wait after clicking Search to allow the grid to update. Note: one elementHash (per_page selector) was not captured reliably in the text dump; a placeholder is included and documented as optional — implementations should either ignore that step when the selector is not present or replace with a selector obtained from the live page. Authentication was performed earlier in the recorded session; this tool assumes the agent/session is already authenticated or can access the admin URL directly in the test environment. The tool intentionally does not attempt to log in (login steps are excluded) because credentials were used interactively in the recording and sessions typically handle authentication separately.
name: magento_admin_transactions_search
description: Automates a Magento Admin Transactions search by filling the grid filter row and clicking Search. Uses recorded stable element hashes from the recorded session to deterministically interact with the filter inputs: ID range, Order ID, Transaction ID, Parent Transaction ID, Payment Method, Transaction Type, Is Closed, Created At range, and executes the Search button. Returns the page content after applying the filters so the caller can inspect results (e.g., total records).

steps.description: Navigate to the Magento admin Transactions grid page (starting point).
Set ID # From (left side of ID range). Leave empty to skip by supplying empty string.
Set ID # To (right side of ID range). Leave empty to skip by supplying empty string.
Input Order ID into its filter input. (Recorded element hash for Order ID input.)
Input Transaction ID into its filter input. (Recorded element hash for Transaction ID input.)
Input Parent Transaction ID if provided. (Recorded element hash from login page interactions; kept for completeness.)
Select the Payment Method dropdown option by visible text. Provide exact label (e.g., 'PayPal Express Checkout'). Leave empty to not change selection.
Select Transaction Type by visible text (Order/Authorization/Capture/Void/Refund). Leave empty to not change selection.
Select Is Closed by visible text ('Yes' or 'No'). Leave empty to not change selection.
Input Created At 'From' date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to skip.
Input Created At 'To' date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to skip.

Optional: set 'View per page' selector. This elementHash is not captured in the recording text dump consistently; provide per_page only if needed. If left empty or element not present the step will effectively be a no-op.
Click the Search button to apply the filters and refresh the grid.
Short wait to allow grid to update after clicking Search.
Return page content for inspection of results and verification.
steps.goal: Capture search results summary and the transactions grid HTML/text after applying filters (e.g., 'Total X records found', and any visible rows).

input_schema.name: id_from
input_schema.description: ID # 'From' value for numeric range filter (use site numeric id). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: id_to
input_schema.description: ID # 'To' value for numeric range filter. Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: order_id
input_schema.description: Order ID to filter by (single-line text). Example: '100000001'.

input_schema.name: transaction_id
input_schema.description: Transaction ID to filter by (single-line text). Example: 'txn_ABC123'.

input_schema.name: parent_transaction_id
input_schema.description: Parent Transaction ID to filter by (single-line text).

input_schema.name: payment_method
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Payment Method option to select in the dropdown. Use the exact option label as displayed (e.g., 'PayPal Express Checkout', 'Cash On Delivery'). Leave empty to skip selecting.

input_schema.name: transaction_type
input_schema.description: Transaction Type visible label to select. Use one of: Order, Authorization, Capture, Void, Refund. Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: is_closed
input_schema.description: Is Closed visible label to select. Use 'Yes' or 'No'. Note: underlying option values are '1' (Yes) and '0' (No) on the site.

input_schema.name: created_from
input_schema.description: Created At 'From' date in format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: created_to
input_schema.description: Created At 'To' date in format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: per_page
input_schema.description: Optional page size (View per page). Valid site options: 20,30,50,100,200. Leave empty to keep default.
